additional_info.subject: ID038344-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R2 170001515] DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 CRM:00797001320
additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Sominath
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R2 170001515
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
cay5wL
Problem Description
:
DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100.  Outlet out of order because of error in the temp. sensor. Measured the PT1000 outputs all fine.
Troubleshooting
:
After reviewing the logs on SCB, we found repeated CableTempSensor errors for the DC1 cable over the past two weeks. We suggest checking the cable temperature sensor for outlet D1 again.
Since you mentioned the issue might be related to the EcoG, we recommend carrying a spare EcoG and cable in case they need to be replaced.
Please see the attached snapshot of the error occurrences for more details.
The errors generated are as follows:
KON: 1: In case the contact temperature sensors are not okay.
PLE: 1:
Plausibility Error (difference of two sensors of same type too high).
VIV: 0: In case of an invalid sensor reading.
Kindly follow the steps below to troubleshoot the fault leading to these error flags:
Step 1: Turn off the power supply to the charger.
Step 2: Identify the cables P1, P2, N1, and N2 associated with Pt1000. Refer to the picture below for your reference.
Step 3: Check the ambient temperature and note it. Then, using a multimeter, measure the resistance of P1, P2, N1, and N2.
Step 4: Click on the following link to see the resistance table of Pt 1000 pertaining to the temperature and its corresponding resistance: Pt1000 Resistance Table
https://www.sterlingsensors.co.uk/pt1000-resistance-table
Kindly refer to the below knowledge article to check the cable sensor:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 and EVSE_TempLowerLimit_ low temperature - Dynamics 365
,,
Note -: KA applicable to DC1 as well.
If you have any questions or need assistance with something, feel free to let me know. I’m here to help!
For future reference, your ticket number is
0383445
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0383445-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R2 170001515] DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 CRM:00797001320
additional_info.body:
Dear
Before the intervention we noticed the screen was completely black so therefor we did an extra investigation on the screen. I was earlier on site in the beginning of the week and then the screen worked completely fine. So in two days it broken.
Checked the power supply of the screen, it was 24V
Screen received a screen update 8 months ago
Display cable is routed according to the new standards (above the PLC)
Replaced the display cable with another one, screen still black
Did several reboots of the charger, no result
Checked the CCV and RFID light cable if they are switched.-> not the case
Therefor we are asking if we can replace the screen.
Br.
